Bind uses opaque retained immutable bytes, raw allocation identity, aligned instruction extent, actual tag equality, exact little-endian words and verified integer-slot bounds. It replaces only ProgramLoad with NativeConstant.
FrameSlot accesses, ABI, dispatch, recovery metadata and source positions remain unchanged. Returned graph/inspection data cannot mutate the template; result retains body owner.

authorityLimit: The trusted loader supplies the canonical handler/tag association and integer-window extent. Actual bytes are checked against that supplied tag, including a wrong-actual-opcode regression, but this does not establish canonical instruction selection for untrusted inputs. No authoritative Nupp loader adapter exists in this cut.

proof.structural: All8 bound canonical graphs contain zero ProgramLoad operations. Only replacements change; ABI/source/exactTypes/terminator/positions/dst stay equal.
proof.negative: Wrong actual tag, distinct retained identity, forged equality, stale local owner, detached/mutated template, unsupported graph/contracts, extents/alignment/window overflow, noninteger/infinite bounds.
proof.vectors: 8 handlers x4 aliases x4 bit vectors: zero, all ones, sign bit, wrapping arithmetic and arbitrary high bits. Original and bound graphs each execute against independent Python word expectations.
proof.dispatch: Test callback explicitly compares next pc+16 and all five forwarded arguments: registers, integer window, task, VM, dispatch table. All four integer slots compared after return.
proof.oracleLimit: Existing native_jit normalizes all signatures to host ABI. Test adapter mechanically changes only return_call_indirect to call_indirect plus return. Production tail ABI remains structurally preserved, not natively proven here.
proof.readabilityRewrite: Generated cases.json and cases.tsv byte-identical before/after Python expansion.
proof.format: All changed Nupp/Lua formatted; git diff --check passed. No broad suite/fixpoint or timing claim for unused isolated module.
